answer: One census return stops bulk fakes: each identity files one in the island register. It names a berth and vessel for its voyage; auditors replay the log, and a reused seal or shared berth burns the bond. Each fake pays 115 (70 bond, 45 fee); 1,000 total 115,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented berth reuses one seal on two returns; duplicates send a ripple through the register, flagging both. An honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps its share.
